caption:
$403 per kW per month: Singapore is the most expensive colocation metro in our index.

The cheapest is São Paulo at $160, so the same kW costs about 2.5× more in Singapore. Hong Kong ($295) and Tokyo ($280) follow, then a surprise: Querétaro, Mexico, at $260, ahead of Frankfurt and every US metro.

Northern Virginia sits near the bottom at $173, but that rate is for 10 MW+ blocks.

Data: Coloprice Colocation Index, October 2026 release. Sources on the last slide.
